# overrides

Severity overrides.

- Toolset name: `overrides`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 5 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_override`

**Create override** · mutating

Create a severity override for an NVT (e.g. mark a finding as false positive by overriding to 0.0). Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | no | Whether the override is active |
| `hosts` | array<string> | no | Restrict to these hosts |
| `new_severity` | string | no | Severity to report instead (string per GMP, e.g. "0.0" for false positive) |
| `nvt_oid` | string | yes | OID of the NVT the override applies to |
| `orphan` | boolean | no | Keep the override even when its result no longer exists |
| `port` | string | no | Restrict to a port, e.g. "22/tcp" |
| `result_id` | string | no | Attach to one specific result by UUID |
| `severity` | string | no | Match results with this severity (string per GMP, e.g. "7.5") |
| `task_id` | string | no | Restrict to one task by UUID |
| `text` | string | no | Justification text |

### `openvas_delete_override`

**Delete override** · destructive

Delete a severity override (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_override`

**Get override** · read-only

Get one severity override by UUID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_overrides`

**List overrides** · read-only

List severity overrides.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_override`

**Update override** · destructive
